# Implement Refactor TODO

1. Take an item from the refactor lists (do not skip big items) in the kolboo project and check if it was done already.

2. If it wasn't done yet, decide if this is a good change.

3. If you think it isn't a good change, use #askQuestions tool to query the user about this.

4. Implement the TODO item. If this is a truly massive change, you may break it up into multiple commits.

5. Remove the item completely from the refactor doc (do not mark done).

6. After you're done, as part of the summary, explain why this is a good change (if it even is).
